Rules the app uses, and where they come from

HR zones as % of heart-rate reserve (Karvonen), labelled as estimateszones, time in zoneResearch RULE-METRIC-01
Max HR: your setting, else the higher of 208 − 0.7 × age and the highest HR held ≥ 5 ssettings, zones, loadResearch RULE-METRIC-02 (Tanaka 2001)
Training load = TRIMP with constants for your sex (male ones while not set)dashboardResearch RULE-METRIC-03 (constants are expert opinion)
Resting HR: your setting, else the median of Apple Health's last 7 daily readings, else 60zones, loadResearch RULE-METRIC-01
Fitness / fatigue as 42 / 7-day averagesdashboardResearch RULE-METRIC-03 — convention; fine as a personal trend
Race prediction: Riegel, exponent 1.06; marathon shown with a "likely too fast" cautiondashboardResearch RULE-METRIC-04
VDOT shown as a race-equivalent score, not VO2maxdashboardResearch RULE-METRIC-05
Heart-rate gaps over 30 s and jumps over 15 bpm/s are flaggedactivity detailResearch RULE-METRIC-07 (thresholds are expert opinion)
Under 50 % of a workout with heart rate: zones, HR chart and split HR hidden; under 90 %: a gaps noteactivity detailYour decision D10; thresholds from your data, which clusters above 90 % or below 50 %
Average / max HR come from the watch's own workout summaryeverywhereYour decision fix for Apple's sparse exports, 2026-10-20
Best-effort distances mirror StravarecordsYour decision
A best effort can't include a gap over 15 s that covers more than 2× the run's typical speedrecords, PRsAssumption from your data, pending your OK
Match an import to a session: same type, same day, ±25 %coachYour decision proposed by me, you approved
A run one day off asks instead of matchingcoachYour decision proposed by me, you approved
No fixed easy / moderate / hard per exercise: "hard" comes only from your session rating or reps in reservecatalog, coachResearch RULE-LOAD-04 (retired 2026-10-21)
Session effort: your 0–10 rating; load = rating × minutes; ≤ 2 easy, 3–4 moderate, ≥ 5 hard (cut-offs are the scale's labels, a convention)activity page, coachResearch RULE-LOAD-01
A logged set is "hard" only when you enter ≤ 3 reps in reserve; without an entry it is neithergym logResearch RULE-LOAD-03, RULE-LOAD-04
A gym session matches a strength workout (traditional or functional) on the same day, whatever its lengthcoachYour decision 2026-10-20: the plan, not the import, says what was done
A finished gym session starts as a copy of its plan, set by set; editing the plan later never changes itgym logYour decision 2026-10-20
Hard sets per muscle per week: 10+ is the growth range, about 3 maintainscoachResearch RULE-WEEK-02 (Schoenfeld 2017; pending the ACSM 2026 check, #24)
Any number of sessions per muscle is fine; only the weekly total is comparedcoachResearch RULE-WEEK-03 (Schoenfeld 2019)
Each exercise counts toward its one catalog muscle group (no partial credit for helper muscles)coachAssumption simplest count; the research gives no rule for it
A run is hard on your rating ≥ 5 or 10+ min above 85 % of heart-rate reserve; nothing recorded → its planned easy/hard; neither → never clashescoach week checkResearch RULE-LOAD-02, RULE-LOAD-04 + D1 (cut-off unvalidated, boundary an estimate)
At most 2 hard runs a week, 48 h apartcoach week checkResearch RULE-REC-02 (weak)
48 h before a muscle group is trained hard again (full body overlaps every group)coach week checkResearch RULE-REC-01 (expert opinion)
No hard legs (legs, glutes, full body) in the 24 h before a hard runcoach week checkResearch RULE-REC-04 + D4 (expert opinion, low confidence)
Sessions have a day but no time: the day before counts as within 24 hcoach week checkAssumption needed to apply the hour rules to day-only sessions
A skipped session is dropped; it may move only to a free later day that breaks no spacing rulecoach week checkResearch RULE-PROG-01 — a design choice, no study (said on screen)
This week's running distance (imported so far + planned to come) vs the mean of the last 2 weeks: noted above +20 %, "big jump" above +30 %; no 10 % capcoach week checkResearch RULE-PROG-02 (weak–moderate; Buist 2008 found the 10 % rule changed nothing)
After 10+ days without a workout, offer easing the rest of the week to 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 % of planned volume (run distance, ride time, gym sets; never reps); undo restores itcoach week checkResearch RULE-PROG-04 + D7 (you choose; thresholds are judgement calls)
More hard runs than max(1, 20 % of the week's runs) gets a notecoach week checkResearch RULE-WEEK-01 (counted by session; D2 still open for the dashboard)
Session templates (one leg day in the gym split)coachResearch RULE-WEEK-04 — runners need 2 strength days with heavy legs — review (M3)
